title: Assemble VPAT evidence and remediate focus + contrast for compact interactive token sets
creator: Ava Patel
description: Run a focused accessibility sweep for the compact/dense token, chip, and pill components used across dashboards (tables, mini-charts, and compact controls). Produce a VPAT evidence packet documenting fixes for ARIA roles, keyboard navigation, visual contrast tokens, and live-region announcements. Coordinate with engineering to land small behavioral fallbacks where CSS-only remediation is insufficient.
acceptance_criteria: All compact token/chip variants have documented ARIA roles and semantics in the component spec (aria-role, aria-pressed, aria-label usage).
Keyboard focus order works predictably in dense lists and table rows with compact tokens; focusable elements are reachable via Tab/Shift+Tab and arrow-key patterns where applicable.
Color token mappings for compact states (default, hover, active, disabled, selected) meet WCAG AA contrast ratios for normal and high-contrast themes.
VPAT evidence packet (PDF) assembled with screenshots, markup snippets, keyboard flow recordings, and a summary of outstanding issues or compensating controls.
Related engineering PRs created and merged for behavioral fixes; QA run and signed off by accessibility reviewer.
tasks: Audit current compact token forms across product pages and identify variants used in tables and chart legends.
Map each visual state to design tokens and check contrast ratios programmatically and manually (axe + manual color meter).
Define ARIA semantics for tokens used as toggles vs. passive labels; update component docs with examples.
Prototype keyboard-only interaction patterns for dense token groups (Tab vs. Arrow key behavior) and validate with keyboard-only testing.
Create VPAT evidence: per-component checklist, annotated screenshots, HTML snippets, and links to PRs and Figma frames.
Work with engineering to add small JS fallbacks for focus management where purely CSS solutions cause layout thrash or visual regressions.
Prepare design sign-off and handover notes for the next release cycle.
comments: 2026-02-11 - Ava Patel: Kickoff notes posted to Confluence with initial list of pages/components. Prioritized compact tokens used in Alerts, Table cells, Mini-legend for sparklines.

2026-02-22 - Accessibility Review (Linda Chen): Suggested using aria-pressed for toggle chips and role='list' + role='listitem' for grouped tokens to preserve semantics for screen readers. Raised concern about arrow-key expectations in grouped chips.

2026-02-28 - Diego Morales: Implemented a lightweight focus ring variant and focus-visible-only approach to reduce visual noise. Created ENG-21567 to handle keyboard arrow navigation in grouped-chips; requested design guidance on preferred arrow semantics.

2026-03-10 - QA (Sofia Ruiz): Recorded keyboard flow videos for dense table rows and attached to Confluence. Found one regression where tab order jumped past an in-row token when pagination control is present.
2026-03-12 - Diego Morales: Merged small PR adjusting tabindex handling and updated docs with examples. Assigned follow-up to ENG-21601 for cross-browser testing on NVDA/JAWS.
